audience: teams that track stock, suppliers and customer orders in BoxHero

useCases.title: Find items that are running low
useCases.text: List the items with their stock per location. Compare each quantity with a minimum-stock attribute, if your team has one, and list the items below it.

useCases.title: Review the latest stock-outs and their customers
useCases.text: List the newest stock transactions, filtered to stock-outs. The entries show the customer where one was set. Open one transaction to see its lines.

useCases.title: Record a stock-in from a supplier
useCases.text: Find the item by its SKU, then the receiving location and the supplier. Record the stock-in with the quantity. Each repeated call records the movement again, so check the transaction list first.

useCases.title: Check what is still to be received on purchase orders
useCases.text: List the purchase orders with their status and estimated date. Open one to see each line and the quantity still to be received.

useCases.title: Add a new item with its opening stock
useCases.text: Read the custom attributes and the locations first. Create the item with its SKU and price, and an opening quantity if you want stock at once.
